feedback.text: The product arrived damaged; I need support.

knowledge_base.title: Synthetic delivery guidance
knowledge_base.text: Check the tracking link in your shipping confirmation. If the tracking status is unclear, contact support with your order reference.

knowledge_base.title: Synthetic returns guidance
knowledge_base.text: To request a return, contact support with your order reference and the reason for the return. Eligibility is reviewed by the support team.
